story.title: Perceptyne Builds AI-Powered Dual-Arm Robots for India's Factory Floors With Flexible Low-Cost Deployment
story.summary: Indian startup Perceptyne is developing AI-driven dual-arm robotic systems designed to automate complex manufacturing tasks that traditional industrial robots cannot perform cost-effectively. The company positions its robots as flexible and affordable enough for mid-sized Indian factories, aiming to reduce the barrier to automation that has historically kept smaller manufacturers from deploying robotics. The startup enters a manufacturing sector where AI-driven automation is increasingly reshaping the nature of factory work across India.
